display-ports.rationale: Exact-model technical specifications establish two USB-A downstream ports.

rental-pet.rationale: The same rental page publishes incompatible 20 kg and 10 kg limits; neither is marked superseded.

repair-scope.rationale: Detailed supported-model list explicitly excludes M4.

rental-door.rationale: Entrance width is irrelevant to bathroom width, which is not published.

display-power.rationale: USB-C alone does not establish power; linked technical sheet returns HTTP 403.

docs-recovery.rationale: The initial guide is inaccessible, but the official documentation index leads to desktop-wide offline operation plus local note creation and editing guides. Together these support both requested actions without internet; the failed route does not establish that all evidence is inaccessible.
